For X1P6 + MD_8b_B + DqSelect=0 (non-SC1 `else branch, sequential if => last match wins, L1728) md_mask=144'hFF0000_000000_000000_000000_000000_000000: FF0000 in the DQ5 24-bit field (bits 143:120) = high 8 bits = beats 16-23 masked (md_mask[i]==1 skips the write in the for-loop, leaving mem_arr bits at init 0). User (U#0 verbatim) pastes the terminal output of ./runsti/gen_stimulus_ltf: three vsim submissions (TT/FF/SS) for WTM001_normal_check 2b16g_BL02_12800 X2P3, each emitting the d6vecgen 'width==X2P3 bank array must start with 2b16g, here is 2b32g' warning, ending with '[INFO] Pass:2, Error:1'. No root cause / fix given by user. Gold-standard (cline assistant, trace 1791457291368_k7hc6, 76 msgs, last=assistant COMPLETE, A#75): the FF corner's probe.tcl is a 0-byte empty file, so xrun/xmsim reports 'xmsim: *W,NORUNCMD: No 'run' command issued.' and the simulation never runs -> no A_Compare.rpt / runCmd / ncsim.shm -> d6vecgen flags FF as ERROR. Root cause in bin/vsim gentbprobefile('local') (lines 1127-1131): the guard if(-e "$worktb/probe.tcl"){} skips re-copying probe.tcl whenever it already exists -- even when empty -- because there is no !-z (non-empty) check; an empty probe.tcl (e.g. from a transient NFS/cp failure on first run) is thus self-perpetuating across all retries. Evidence chain: (1) vecgen.rpt: FF 2b16g X2P3 12800 ERROR across retries, TT/SS PASS. (2) FF/probe.tcl empty 0 bytes vs TT/SS probe.tcl 35 lines with run/exit. (3) FF/*.out contains xmsim: *W,NORUNCMD: No 'run' command issued. (4) FF missing A_Compare.rpt/runCmd/ncsim.shm; TT/SS have them. (5) bin/vsim:1127-1131 gentbprobefile local branch if(-e "$worktb/probe.tcl"){} with no !-z. (6) TT runCmd present with vsim command lines. (7) d6vecgen:593 emits the 2b32g->2b16g bank-array replacement warning (orthogonal to the ERROR).
